title: Notes
summary: Notes, checklists, photos and reminders: quick, private and ad-free.
description:
**Notes** keeps your notes, checklists and photos on your phone: quick to write, easy to find, and without an account, ads or a subscription.

### Write
- **A new note in one tap**, with the keyboard already up. A checklist or a note with a photo is one tap too.
- **Checklists** you can tick in the shop: ticked items fold away at the bottom, drag the handle to reorder, untick everything for next week, and paste a few lines to get one item a line.
- **Photos** from the camera or your pictures, in any note.
- Undo and redo while you type, a word count, and every change saved by itself.

### Organise
- **Pin** what matters to the top, give notes a **colour**, and group them with **labels**.
- **Archive** what you want to keep but not see every day: a sideways swipe does it.
- **The trash** keeps deleted notes for 30 days, says on each note how long it has left, and lets you restore it. Undo after every delete.
- A grid or a list, sorted by last edited, date created or title.

### Find
- **Search everything**: titles, text, checklist items and labels, with or without accents. Filters for checklists, reminders, photos, pinned notes, labels and colours. Archived notes are searched too.

### Remember
- **Reminders** on any note at the date and time you choose: once, or every day, on weekdays, every week, month or year, with Snooze and Done. They ring while the app is closed.
- **Home-screen widgets** with your pinned notes or your most recent ones.

### Your data
- **Bring your notes**: imports this app's own notes file and the CSV most notes apps and spreadsheets save, with a title and a text column and, when they are there, labels, colours, pins and dates. Lines that start with "- [ ]" become a checklist.
- **Save everything** as a notes file the app reads back, or as a CSV for spreadsheets. Share a note's text and photos with any app.
- Everything stays on this phone and in Zapli's backup of your apps.
- **In English and Slovak.**

### What it never does
- No ads, no tracking, no analytics, no account, no sign-in, no upsells.
- It cannot connect to the internet: nothing leaves your phone unless you share or save it.

### Privacy
Notes are marked as personal data. An optional app lock keeps them behind your fingerprint, face or screen lock: turn it on in the app's permissions. Reminders can hide the note's text.
